review.notes: Full review. Seeded sample of 15 sections (1.3, 1.4, 2.1, 3.1, 3.3, 3.4, 3.7, 3.10, 3.11, 4.1, 4.3, 5.2, 5.5, 5.9, 6.3) checked against 22 Lean files and the contents list of the formal proof at commit 72fead1, plus Rallis Prop. 1.1 and Gan-Qiu-Takeda Thm 7.3, Props 11.1-11.2; 4.1 by computation only (its file and that of 5.11 could not be read). Findings: 3.11 (c) lacks the equivariance hypothesis (counterexample over F_3); arrangement still follows the source's contents list (re-raised); six passages still share the source's wording. Earlier findings on the missing supplier, the doubled power in 6.2, the second statement of Theorem C and the uncited complementary-space identity are repaired. Dependency check: 122 roadmaps, 1385 edges, 0 problems; section graph of the family acyclic (412 sections). Suggested.lean elaborates with no output and states nothing (no headline statable at the pins). Automatic checks set aside: a code span wrapped over a line break, source declaration names on pointer lines, and the umbrella change, which a maintainer's comment records as decided. Background entries and two-way supply are passed to the human reviewers, as the description says they were decided.
